_note: Each week, PREPEND a new round object at the top of 'rounds' and commit. Set the previous round's live=false and add a 'summary' (e.g. '3W-5L · +9.55u'). Never delete old rounds; the function shows the most recent 8. Tier arrays (bronze/silver/gold) are cumulative — higher tiers also receive lower-tier tips.

bronze.reason: The Eels are without both recognised halves — Mitch Moses (confirmed out) and Jonah Pezet — running a makeshift spine against a Raiders side chasing the eight. Parramatta were already the comp's leakiest defence. Saturday 7:35pm AEST at CommBank Stadium.
bronze.note: Eels pinched it 15–12 — Parramatta's patched-up spine held on. Didn't go our way.

bronze.reason: Value on the road against a West Coast side missing Reuben Ginbey, with the Eagles short on run. ⚠️ Indicative price — confirm both teams at the Thursday drop and check your bookie. Saturday 4:15pm AEST, Optus Stadium.
bronze.note: Nailbiter at Optus — North held on 74–73 (10.14 to 10.13). Got there by a point.

silver.reason: The Roosters lose their entire spine to Origin — Tedesco, Walker, Robson and Radley all out — while the Dolphins keep their attack intact at home. Isaako and Farnworth both confirmed named. Friday 8:00pm AEST at Suncorp Stadium.
silver.note: Dolphins romped it 48–10 and Farnworth crossed, but Isaako didn't get a try (kicked seven goals instead) — one leg short.

silver.reason: Geelong are short favourites at home with Gold Coast among the worst in the comp at stopping small forwards. Martin has kicked a goal in 8 straight at GMHBA; Mannagh has had bags of 3, 4, 3 and 5. ⚠️ Tom Stewart out (concussion). Build it in your bookie app to confirm the price. Friday 7:40pm AEST, GMHBA Stadium.
silver.note: Geelong won big, 105–60, but the multi needed both Martin and Mannagh to goal and neither did — leg down.

gold.match: South Sydney Rabbitohs vs Brisbane Broncos
gold.reason: Gold exclusive. Broncos have dropped five straight and are without Walsh, Haas, Staggs and Carrigan. Johnston is the greatest tryscorer the game has seen and Souths are home and desperate for the points. ⚠️ Origin outs both ways — confirm the teams before backing. Thursday 7:50pm AEST at Accor Stadium.
gold.note: Clean sweep — Souths 48–6, Johnston bagged four and Fifita crossed. Every leg home.

gold.reason: Gold exclusive. Three win plays across both codes, three different games Friday through Sunday — no correlation, no Thursday rush. Dolphins and Raiders are confirmed; GWS is indicative until teams drop. Build it in your bookie app to confirm the combined.
gold.note: Dolphins saluted, but the Raiders went down to the Eels (15–12) and GWS lost to St Kilda — multi gone.

legs: NRL · Alofiana Khan-Pereira 2+ Tries — Warriors v Sharks ($2.75)
NRL · Isaako + Farnworth Try Double (Same Game Multi) — Dolphins v Roosters ($3.00)
NRL · Johnston 2+ Tries + Fifita Try (Same Game Multi) — Souths v Broncos ($7.50)
gold.reason: Gold exclusive. Five in-form scorers stacked across three games, with the 2+ try legs for the kick. All NRL, all confirmed players. It almost certainly won't land — that's the point. Small stake only, one unit max.
gold.note: The Johnston-and-Fifita leg landed, but Khan-Pereira didn't bag two and the Isaako double missed. Long-shot, as billed.

bronze.reason: Geelong have won 9 of their last 10 against Adelaide, and the Crows are without Rankine (calf) and Thilthorpe (suspended) — both key forwards out at once. All five of our rules fire; the strongest single of the round. ⚠️ TONIGHT 7:30pm AEST — get set early and check it hasn't started. Line has crept from -8.5 toward -9.5 as money comes for the Cats.
bronze.note: Heartbreaker — Adelaide pinched it by a single point, 75–74. Geelong couldn't quite get there.

bronze.reason: The Dolphins get a swag of key players back in one hit — Tabuai-Fidow, Farnworth and Nikorima all return, several off Origin duty — at full strength for the first time in weeks against a largely unchanged Cowboys side. Saturday 5:30pm AEST in Townsville.
bronze.note: Comfortable in Townsville, 40–14 — a full-strength Dolphins were far too good. Easy winner.

bronze.match: Gold Coast Suns vs Brisbane Lions
bronze.reason: QClash at home against a Brisbane side missing Coleman (~6 weeks) and Lester. Gold Coast sit 5th with top-four ambitions; home ground plus a depleted Brisbane backline is the case. Saturday 5:15pm AEST.
bronze.note: QClash boilover — Brisbane ran out 106–75 on the road. Didn't go our way.

silver.match: Cronulla Sharks vs St George Illawarra
silver.reason: Sharks strong home favourites. With Hynes and Brailey both out, fullback Kennedy is even more central to the attack and is a proven scorer; Nikora a running back-rower who adds a third scorer in a winning side.
silver.note: All three legs landed — Sharks won 34–12, with Kennedy and Nikora both crossing. Clean SGM.

silver.reason: Comp's top side heading to Bunbury against a North side outside the eight. Amiss has kicked four goals in each of his last two games. When Freo win big and North struggle to score, the total stays suppressed — the legs line up directionally.
silver.note: Freo won big (by 124), but the multi died on two legs: Amiss kicked 2 (needed 3) and the total sailed over the line.

gold.reason: Gold exclusive. Penrith back at full strength — Cleary, Yeo and To'o all return — while the Tigers have multiple changes. To'o is a high-volume tryscorer in a likely blowout, with Yeo a longer-odds second scorer to lift the multi.
gold.note: Clean sweep — Penrith 68–0, To'o bagged 2 and Yeo scored. Every leg home.

gold.reason: Gold exclusive. Carlton carry real momentum against a struggling Essendon. McKay is primed after a couple of quieter weeks, and with Carlton expected to win comfortably the total should climb. Confirm the Over line in your builder.
gold.note: Carlton won 72–67 and McKay kicked his 3, but only 139 points were scored — the Over missed, so the multi went down.

legs: AFL · Gold Coast Suns to Win ($1.54)
gold.reason: Gold exclusive. Four of the round's cleanest win plays across both codes, all different games on Sat/Sun — no correlation. Fremantle and Carlton are short anchors; the Dolphins and Suns add the meat. A quality multi, not a long-shot.
gold.note: Three of four got there — Dolphins, Freo and Carlton all won — but Gold Coast went down to Brisbane, so the multi just missed.
